payload.summary: On Call Playbook: every unlinked scenario repeats a full 'No local guideline linked' block, and every card briefly says its guideline is unavailable while loading
payload.detail: on-call-playbook-section.tsx:86-105 renders an EmptyState with a Search documents button per scenario (6 in demo, page is 4000px tall at 390px). useOnCallLinkedDocuments (lib/on-call/linked-documents.ts) returns {} with no loading flag, so all cards read 'unavailable' and file under Unlinked until lookups finish; Orientation has the same flash. The date shown is updated_at, not the guideline's review date.
